specialties.Grow: Speeds growth of plants, trees and crops.
specialties.Burn: Lights fires; runs the Smelting furnace; bakes Brick.
specialties.Chop: Cuts trees; turns Small logs into Lumber.
specialties.Crush: Breaks rocks; runs the Concrete mixer; makes paint from berries.
specialties.Bulldoze: Clears and flattens land for big builds.
specialties.Litter: Drops materials around its home (leaves, fluff, honey, clay…).
specialties.Recycle: Turns Wastepaper into Paper, garbage into ore.
